delivery: Uncommitted local UX fixes; not a release

environment.metadata: Dedicated PostgreSQL QA database and isolated test schemas
environment.browser: Native local Chrome; no browser automation framework added

gates.warning: Vite application bundle remains above its 500 kB advisory threshold.

regressions: Catalog query view excludes non-executable entries; pagination binds the selected view.
Concept details preserve the authorized projection and exclude unmapped/private fields.
Suggested JSON Pointer bindings use the existing execution restrictions; query text, operation names and Redis command options are excluded.
HTTP API template generation preserves integer/decimal lexemes and leaves optional parameters without a configured value absent.
Single-answer evaluation rejects baseline capture and persists its mode, real-call statistics, manual verdict and independent history summary.
chrome_before_environment_restart: Connected HTTP API sources advance onboarding while permission evidence stays unverified.
Customer concept shows mapped fields and relationships; an Agent template preview returns two PostgreSQL rows, Back to concept retains context and Escape returns focus.
SQL text/JSON switching preserves 9007199254740993 and an exact decimal; cancelled editing does not persist changes.
HTTP API operation selection creates a parameterized template; trial and publication complete against the local demo API.
Entity filtering limits ontology mapping rows; Discover fields offers PostgreSQL metadata fields without reading samples.
chrome_final_runtime: 390x844 Chinese catalog has stacked filters and query cards; fixed operation/query previews fit the viewport with a reachable action footer.
Template preview executes a real two-row PostgreSQL query; Escape returns keyboard focus to the preview trigger.
Agent attention link opens the matching row, focuses it, expands its actions and displays Expiring soon.
Single-answer workflow: enter question/criteria, start capture, execute one MCP template call, collect, mark correct, save and open history.
After the final rebuild and restart, history shows two completed/reviewed single checks and two correct verdicts instead of zero completed comparison pairs.
Settings section navigation, language selection and responsive rendering exercised; two missing section translations and unlocalized onboarding status strings corrected afterward.
Chrome console showed no application errors during catalog/preview checks; a password-form username accessibility advisory was corrected in the final build.

runtime.configuration_storage: Persistent directory mounted separately from metadata

limitations: Full 18-product / 20-version database matrix was not rerun.
No new amd64 build, distribution, GitHub publication or OTLP receiver revalidation.

Chrome intermittently returned ScreenCaptureKit -3811 after the local restart. Final audit repair-link navigation and the last translation-only patch were not rechecked in Chrome; backend tests and final UI build passed.

The former QA services on ports 19843/19844 cannot decrypt their retained metadata after their temporary master-key directories disappeared on restart. Existing metadata was preserved. Available repository backup keys did not match; recovery requires the original matching key. The new QA instance uses independent metadata and persistent key storage.
